name: dv-public-repo-guard
description: Pre-commit guard for public repositories: blocks absolute home paths and e-mail addresses in staged text files, in zip-based files (FCStd, 3mf, Office, OpenDocument, epub) and in PNG/JPEG metadata. Stdlib-only checker, hook template and a PNG text-chunk stripper.

interface.shortDescription: Block home paths and e-mail addresses before they reach a public repository
interface.longDescription: One skill with a standard-library Python checker and a pre-commit hook template: scans staged text files, members of zip-based files (FCStd, 3mf, docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, epub, zip) and PNG/JPEG metadata for absolute home paths and e-mail addresses, plus a stripper for PNG text chunks.
defaultPrompt: Use the Public Repo Guard skill to set up a pre-commit personal-data check for this public repository.
